note: Dead NPCs now drop the weapons and armor they were actually wearing — a guard corpse holds its sword, breastplate, helmet and shield as real loot you can take and equip, not placeholder gold. Taking a piece visibly strips it off the corpse: loot the sword and the hand is empty, take everything and the body is bare of gear. Unlooted gear stays on the body through save and reload, and looted gear never comes back
